data.name: Iqraatun
data.gender_notes: Iqraatun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'iqr' which means 'to read'. It is a beautiful name for a girl born into a family that values education and knowledge. The name Iqraatun carries the meaning “To Read” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Iqraatun usually hope their child will grow to embody to read and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages a love for learning and intellectual growth.
data.etymology: Iqraatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To Read.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iqraatun total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إقراءتن
in_arabic.long_meaning: إقراءتن هو اسم مشتق من القراءة والتعلم، ويشير إلى أهمية القراءة في الإسلام كما ورد في القرآن الكريم 'اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق'، ويعبر عن قيمة العلم والتعلم في الحياة

in_urdu.name: اقراٹن
in_urdu.meaning: اقراٹن کا مطلب ہے پڑھنا، سیکھنا اور سمجھنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اقراٹن ایک ایسا نام ہے جو قرآت اور تعلیم سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس میں تعلیم اور علم کی اہمیت پر زور دیا گیا ہے جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں آیا ہے 'اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق'، یہ نام زندگی میں علم اور تعلیم کی قدر کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इक़रातुन
in_hindi.meaning: इक़रातुन का अर्थ है पढ़ना, सीखना और समझना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इक़रातुन एक ऐसा नाम है जो पढ़ाई और शिक्षा से लिया गया है, और इसमें शिक्षा और ज्ञान के महत्व पर बल दिया गया है जैसा कि कुरआन में कहा गया है 'اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق', यह नाम जीवन में ज्ञान और शिक्षा के मूल्य को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: اقراټن
in_pashto.meaning: اقراټن د لوستلو، زده کړې او پوهې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: اقراټن یو داسې نوم دی چی د لوستلو او زده کړې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او پدې کې د تعلیم او پوهې اهمیت ټینګ وي لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې راغلی دی 'اقرأ باسم ربك الذي خلق'، دا نوم په ژوند کې د پوهې او زده کړې ارزښت ښيي

in_english.name: Iqraatun
in_english.meaning: Iqraatun means reading, learning, and understanding
in_english.long_meaning: Iqraatun is a name derived from the Arabic root 'qara'a', meaning to read or recite. It emphasizes the importance of reading, learning, and seeking knowledge, as mentioned in the Quran 'Read in the name of your Lord'. The name signifies the value of education, wisdom, and spiritual growth in Islam, reflecting a profound connection to Islamic heritage and tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name "Iqraatun" is of great significance in terms of cultural impact, as it emphasizes the importance of literacy and knowledge acquisition in Islamic tradition. In the Quran, there is a verse (Al-Alaq, 96:1) that contains God's command to the Prophet Muhammad: "Read in the name of your Lord who created man from a clot of blood. Recite, for your Lord is the most Munificent one who taught you the scripture, the way, and the wisdom." (Yusuf Ali translation).
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Iqraatun" holds deep spiritual significance as it is woven into the very fabric of Islamic teachings. It not only reflects the importance of seeking knowledge in practical life, but it also symbolizes a seeker's connection with the divine. By being cognizant of the command "iqra" (read), the believer is striving to be closer to their Creator as stated in the aforementioned verse. Reading the Quran, understanding its meaning, and applying it to one's daily life is one of the most essential acts of worship and is considered a pathway to God.
